findings.title: Telemetry validation accepts a tool interval longer than its enclosing turn
findings.evidence: A full validate_run on an explicitly TEST ONLY copied run accepts capability-WORKSPACE latencyMs=0, toolDurationMs=5000. A second copy accepts 5000ms latency/tool duration inside a 232586814ns outer execution. Receipt membership, source hashes, environment relocation and byte counts are recomputed so this is a semantic test beyond transport hashes.
findings.impact: OBS-SBX04 malformed/forged telemetry and clock-anomaly rejection is incomplete. This does not falsify the three actual captures or show an attacker can mint an accepted actual receipt.
findings.requiredResolution: For this fixed local fixture, reject or mark inconclusive temporal impossibilities, including toolDurationMs greater than latencyMs. Validate consistency against captured execution bounds with an explicit clock/tolerance model if using cross-clock comparisons. Add full copied-record negative coverage and retain honest actual receipts. Do not normalize raw clocks or change the engine.

diagnosticCopies: All re-signed copies under D are TEST ONLY; none is an accepted actual capture.
trustBoundary: Externally expected authority/packet/attempt receipt hashes are operator/Lead inputs. Own receipt hashed independently from controlled I1 capture. A digest/receipt binds captured bytes, not arbitrary host/code provenance.
limits: Bootstrap deviation: first shell hashed packet and 24+6, but not the 1061 authority sources. Second shell failed on dictionary schema; third persisted all 1061 before semantic reads. Initial exact shell commands/streams/exits remain in tool transcript, not fully reproduced as wrapper records in D. The error is retained in integrity-before.json and this report.

Later command records capture exact child argv/cwd/exit and full raw streams through capture.py. Python outer wrapper inherits its host environment plus documented cache overrides; every executed Node observation, fixed child and focused quality command uses the recorded allowlist and private HOME/TMP/XDG. Wrapper itself has no independent output cap/deadline; trusted candidate launcher enforces its own bounds.

Tool display truncated some long outputs; D/*.stdout files are complete. No claim of globally complete hostile-host provenance, compiled/native/ABI dependency attestation, OS containment, or sandbox security PASS.

The prescribed current runner internally reads the frozen 465-pin inventory in source_paths(). I1 did not manually inspect that historical proposal or prior reviews/reports/results. Its only role in the prescribed execution is source path/hash inventory, checked against the externally pinned 1061-source authority.

Source/cache assertions cover the enumerated 24+6+1061 set and controlled output paths, not a complete host filesystem trace. Node compile/tsx caches disabled; Python -B/PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE used. No network/services/providers/PG/native helper/install/shared-cache write was invoked by I1.
